subject: Reorient intro demo → collaborative POC sprint (dates & agenda)
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena@finmetrics.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@finmetrics.com
Date: 2027-11-14T15:10:00-08:00
Subject: Intro demo: Redwood Inference x FinMetrics

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the invite — we were looking forward to the intro demo you proposed for next week. Quick update: several folks on our side (including our Head of Data and one of our platform architects) will be traveling the week of the 22nd for an end-of-quarter review. Given that and the fact this is a cross-functional initiative, would you be open to switching the session from a high-level intro to a more hands-on scoping workshop?

Goal would be to align on a minimal POC plan, API/network requirements, and a short list of test prompts/metrics we can measure. If a half-day workshop is possible we could invite engineers and procurement together and make faster progress.

Elena
Head of Platform
FinMetrics

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@finmetrics.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-14T16:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro demo: Redwood Inference x FinMetrics

Elena — appreciate the heads up. Absolutely — we can reorient this from a product demo to a collaborative POC scoping workshop. That actually works well: a live, half-day workshop will help us capture the technical constraints early (networking, data privacy, sequence lengths, SLOs) and will give your procurement team what they need to move the contract forward.

Proposed options (US/PST times in parenthesis):
- Option A: 2027-11-18, 9:00am–12:30pm (PST) — half-day working session + 30m wrap
- Option B: 2027-11-19, 10:00am–2:00pm (PST) — extended slot to include procurement intro
- Option C: 2027-11-22, 8:30am–12:00pm (PST) — we can split into two focused blocks (arch/infra + procurement)

Attached is a draft agenda and a short prework spreadsheet we ask participants to fill out (systems touched, firewall egress, expected token volumes). Monica will lead the prework intake and coordinate invites. Marcus can run the technical deep-dive portion.

If one of the dates above looks good, I’ll send a calendar hold and a short HubSpot note for the procurement team. Also — if you prefer a remote whiteboard + breakout rooms, we’ll bring a facilitator.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0187

Attachments: agenda_collab_poc_draft.pdf, prework_prompt_set.xlsx
From: Elena Rossi <elena@finmetrics.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@finmetrics.com, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-15T09:17:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro demo: Redwood Inference x FinMetrics

Thanks Ben — Option A (11/18 morning) looks best for the engineering group, but procurement has a standing sync that morning. Option B (11/19) gets both teams to join but we lose an early-morning slot for some folks on the east coast.

Two asks from procurement: 1) can you include a short pre-billing/estimate line item so we can fast-track approvals if the POC requires reserved capacity, and 2) is there a statement of data handling during the POC (cloud regions, retention, logs) we can attach to our SOW?

Also, a quick note — our Director of Data Science wants a short technical pre-brief (30m) the day before to share prompt examples and expected evaluation criteria. Can Redwood facilitate that?

Onboarding point: happy to share a small sample dataset (anonymized) ahead of time — send secure upload instructions if you have an S3 presign or Drive folder.

Elena

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@finmetrics.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-15T11:48:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro demo: Redwood Inference x FinMetrics

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear asks. Quick answers below and next steps: 

1) Pricing/estimate: I’m attaching a brief example estimate using our POC template that shows both hosted and dedicated options and an approximate token-based cost for a 2-week evaluation. That should give procurement the line item they need.

2) Data handling: we have a standard POC security checklist (region controls, retention policy, and audit log notes). I’ll attach the checklist and a one-page note you can include with the SOW. For uploads, please use the secure Drive link I included in the HubSpot doc; if you need S3 presigned URLs we can generate them — tell us which bucket you prefer.

3) Pre-brief: Marcus is available for a 30-minute pre-brief on 2027-11-17 at 10:00am (PST). He’ll review the prompt examples and propose evaluation metrics.

Proposed next steps:
- Elena confirms preferred workshop date (11/18 or 11/19) — if procurement can accept a later start time on 11/19 we’ll pick that.
- FinMetrics fills the prework spreadsheet by 11/16 EOD so Marcus can tailor the pre-brief.
- I’ll upload the estimate and security checklist to the Drive folder and send a calendar invite once date is locked.

Thanks — Monica Patel
Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: estimate_poc_template.pdf, poc_security_checklist.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@finmetrics.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, procurement@finmetrics.com
Date: 2027-11-17T09:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro demo: Redwood Inference x FinMetrics

Great — thanks everyone. Per the thread, FinMetrics has confirmed 11/19 (Option B) at 10:00am–2:00pm (PST) to accommodate procurement. Monica has uploaded the estimate and checklist to the shared Drive, and Marcus will run the 30-minute pre-brief on 11/18 at 10:00am (PST).

I’ve attached the updated agenda and placed a calendar invite in the shared folder; I’ll send invites to the attendee list once Elena confirms the final participant roster. For procurement, I’ll also add a short line in the HubSpot deal note summarizing potential dedicated capacity needs and a one-week reserved estimate.

Looking forward — we’ll come prepared with a short integration checklist and a small demo harness to run one prompt set live if you’re comfortable.

Ben
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
